case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

response.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
response.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully reviewed your updated volume forecast and delivery data, and have factored these into our revised calculation. We are pleased to support the 36-month contract to provide you with long-term stability, but we must request a 60-day payment term rather than 90 days. With this adjustment to the payment terms, we can offer you a revised unit price of €5.55.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €5.55 per unit with a contract term of 36 months.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 5 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. Furthermore, with overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.
